response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord t JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.trader_type, p.cnt AS count, 1.0 * p.cnt / s.total_cnt AS share, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE p.cnt > s.avg_cnt;

assumptions.assumption: Only transaction records whose trdref exactly matches a trader's tradereg are kept (inner join), so unmatched records are dropped.
GROUP BY on tradekind places NULL tradekind records in one group of their own, and that group is included in the per-type counts and the average.
The average and total run only over groups that have at least one matched record, so trader types with no matched records are not included as zero-count groups.
If there are no matched records, AVG is NULL and the WHERE clause returns no rows, which matches 'return nothing if the average is missing'.
The database is PostgreSQL-style (JSONB, NUMERIC). AVG over integer counts returns an exact numeric, and 1.0 * count forces non-truncating division, so nothing is rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: The average and total cover all four documented trader_type_enum values (Market Maker, Broker, Individual, Institution), with zero counts for any type that has no matched records. Any other or NULL tradekind value still forms its own group.
alternatives.sql: WITH types(trader_type) AS (VALUES ('Market Maker'), ('Broker'), ('Individual'), ('Institution')), matched AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord t JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), per_type AS (SELECT ty.trader_type, COALESCE(m.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM types ty LEFT JOIN matched m ON m.trader_type = ty.trader_type UNION ALL SELECT m.trader_type, m.cnt FROM matched m WHERE m.trader_type IS NULL OR m.trader_type NOT IN (SELECT trader_type FROM types)), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.trader_type, p.cnt AS count, 1.0 * p.cnt / s.total_cnt AS share, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE p.cnt > s.avg_cnt;
